evals.prompt: Use the shared-assets skill. I put our common skills into the shared directory and registered it in the config on every instance, but the instances still behave exactly as before. Did the registration fail? In this session you can only read files and answer in text: say which commands you would run or print, in what order, and what you would check. Answer in at most 250 words, then end with a line starting 'Rules from the skill:' that lists, comma-separated, the finding ids, flags, commands and refusals from the skill that you relied on.
evals.expected_output: No: extra directories are the lowest load priority, so per-instance copies still shadow the shared ones. The fix is to move the local copies to quarantine and re-verify which path each loaded asset resolved from.
expectations: The answer identifies the leftover per-instance copies as shadows
The answer says to move the shadows aside instead of deleting them
The answer says to verify by checking the resolved path of a loaded asset, not just that it is registered
